name: M5Stick Dodge - 4 Wave Challenge
author: coreymillia + GitHub Copilot CLI
description: Fun dodge game with 4 progressive difficulty waves! Control a rotating T-piece and dodge falling Tetris pieces, colorful TETRIS letters, and creative block patterns. Features sequential letter spelling (T-E-T-R-I-S with backwards R!), unique shapes like hearts, arrows, and diamonds, and endless mixed chaos in wave 4+.
features: 🎮 4 unique difficulty waves with different obstacle types
🔤 Sequential TETRIS letters spell T-E-T-R-I-S with retro backwards R
🎨 Colorful Tetris pieces (I, O, T, S, Z, L, J)
💎 Creative block patterns: hearts, arrows, diamonds, stairs, crosses
🔄 Rotate player piece with joystick button
📊 Progressive difficulty - faster spawning and movement
♾️ Endless gameplay with wave 4+ mixed chaos

wave_system.wave_1: Tetris Pieces (0-30s) - Classic falling tetrominos with 7 different shapes
wave_system.wave_2: TETRIS Letters (30-60s) - Sequential colorful letters T→E→T→R→I→S repeating
wave_system.wave_3: Pattern Shapes (60-90s) - 8 creative block patterns (plus, diamond, arrow, heart, zig-zag, cross, stairs, dot)
wave_system.wave_4_plus: Mixed Chaos (90s+) - Random mix of all three types with increasing speed

controls.Joystick: Move player in all directions (portrait mode: Up=right, Down=left, Left=up, Right=down)

requirements: Mini Joy C Hat (required for joystick control)

specifications.scoring: +10 points per survived obstacle, level up every 100 points

games_included.name: Dodge
games_included.description: The main 4-wave dodge challenge with Tetris pieces, letters, and patterns

gameplay_tips: 1. Watch the wave indicator (W:1, W:2, W:3, W:4+) in top-right corner
2. Wave 2 letters spell TETRIS in order - predict the sequence!
3. Rotate your player piece to fit through tight gaps
4. Stay near the center for more escape routes
5. Each level increases speed - prepare for the chaos!
6. Wave 4+ mixes everything - stay alert for all types

technical_details.tetris_pieces: 7 types (I, O, T, S, Z, L, J) with 4 rotation states
technical_details.pattern_shapes: 5x5 bitmap grid scaled 4x (plus, diamond, arrow, heart, zig, cross, stairs, dot)
technical_details.collision_method: Per-pixel overlap detection for all block types
technical_details.spawn_interval: Starts at 1500ms, reduces by 15-20% per level
technical_details.drawing_style: Retro pixel art with outline borders

version_history.1.0.0: Initial release - 4 wave system with Tetris pieces, sequential TETRIS letters (with backwards R!), and 8 creative block patterns. Fixed menu graphics with scattered pieces and letters.

credits.development: Built collaboratively with GitHub Copilot CLI
credits.special_features: Backwards R in TETRIS letters for retro arcade style
